replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
It's cool I suppose, but I can't help but feel it's "empty". You have a lot of flatness in certain spots and don't use any structures to bring out the theme of the map; the areas that should contain something were just replaced with trees over and over which make the map less exciting. 

I'd also prefer if you didn't use lava in a map like this; one accidental move and you're on fire for 10 seconds.
